description: Permanent or persistent textural and pigmentary changes left after inflammatory acne.

appearance.general: Atrophic depressions, rolling or boxcar scars, ice-pick scars, or raised scars may remain after acne.
appearance.dark_skin: Post-inflammatory pigmentation and hypertrophic or keloid scarring may be more prominent in skin of colour.

doctor_discussion_points: Discuss whether the remaining change is true scar tissue, pigmentary change, or both.
